Subject: Follow-up from today's discovery — quick recap + materials

Alex,

Thanks again for taking the call this morning — appreciate the time. Quick recap so we have the same picture:

- Primary goal: reduce document-processing inference cost and latency for Aurora's claims ingestion pipeline.
- Current stack: in-house transformer on A100s with ephemeral batching; pain points are token cost variability and long tail latency for burst loads.
- Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent controls, data residency overnight in us-east-1, procurement timeline ~Q2 decision window.

Attachments: demo recording (redwood-demo-recording.mp4) and a one-page proposed minimum operating plan (proposed-mop.xlsx).

Short request: could you rate where this sits on your priority list right now (1-5) and whether the procurement timeline is still Q2? Two quick next-step options if there's still interest:

Option A — 30m technical deep-dive (engine/runtime tuning + estimated unit cost) — dates next week OK.
Option B — short POC proposal and timeline I can share with your infra lead to validate compliance constraints.

If neither, a one-line no-go helps us avoid cluttering your inbox. I'll follow up in a week if I don't hear back.

Best,

Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com | (415) 555-0127
